title: Hollow-count bookkeeping is opaque: resting Fenmarch's drowned congregation (a full quest chain, its own bell-ringing climax, a big score reward, 'Quest done' line) did not increment 'Hollows rested' in status, while Hollowbrook's Old Court and the Fallows' Long Furrow did — nothing explains why the drowned nave isn't one of the 'eight holds, eight unrested griefs' toward opening Coldpass, which made planning how many hollows were still needed guesswork.
